panels.description: Shows the average number of processes waiting for CPU time on the selected node over the last 1 minute.

targets.expr: max by(instance) (node_load15{instance=~"$node", dc=~"$job"})

panels.title: CPU Load Average (15min)

panels.description: System load  over all CPU cores together
panels.title: Sys Load

panels.description: Shows CPU pressure percentage per node — higher values indicate processes waiting for CPU time due to CPU contention.
panels.title: CPU Pressure

panels.description: Shows the total physical memory available on the selected node

targets.expr: max by(instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance=~"$node", dc=~"$job"})

panels.title: Total RAM

panels.description: Shows the percentage of memory currently used on the selected node after excluding available memory.

targets.expr:
100 *
(
(
max by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance=~"$node", dc=~"$job"})
-
max by(instance)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{instance=~"$node", dc=~"$job"})
)
/
max by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance=~"$node", dc=~"$job"})
)

panels.title: RAM Used (%)

panels.description: Shows current memory pressure on the selected node, indicating whether processes are waiting because memory resources are constrained.
panels.title: Memory Pressure

panels.description: Shows incoming network traffic received by the selected node across network interfaces.
panels.title: Network Receive Traffic

panels.description: Shows outgoing network traffic sent by the selected node across all active network interfaces, excluding loopback traffic.
panels.title: Network Transmit Traffic

panels.description: Shows the total storage capacity of the selected node for the root filesystem (/)
panels.title: Total Disk Size

panels.description: Shows the available free storage space on the selected node for the root filesystem.
panels.title: Free Disk

panels.description: Shows the currently used storage space on the selected node for the root filesystem
panels.title: Used Disk

panels.description: Shows the percentage of disk currently used on the selected node for the root filesystem.

targets.expr:
100 * (
(
max(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$node", mountpoint="/", fstype!=""})
-
max(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance=~"$node", mountpoint="/", fstype!=""})
)
/
max(node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance=~"$node", mountpoint="/", fstype!=""})
)

panels.title: Disk Usage (%)

floor((time() - node_boot_time_seconds{dc="$job", bare_metal="false", k8s!="true"}) / 86400)

"$1",
"nodename",
"(.*)"
)
